stencils.center_pixel: Nuolja local grid cell (2.5 km x 2.5 km)
stencils.3x3_neighborhood: 8 surrounding cells (7.5 km x 7.5 km box)
stencils.5x5_neighborhood: 24 surrounding cells (12.5 km x 12.5 km box)

spatial_feature_formulations.upstream_cloud_fraction: cloud_area_fraction evaluated at upstream cell (x0 - dx, y0 - dy) along opposite 700 hPa wind vector (-U700, -V700)
spatial_feature_formulations.downstream_cloud_fraction: cloud_area_fraction evaluated at downstream cell (x0 + dx, y0 + dy) along 700 hPa wind vector (U700, V700)
spatial_feature_formulations.cross_wind_cloud_gradient: (N_right - N_left) / (2 * dn) along orthogonal vector (-V700, U700)
spatial_feature_formulations.cloud_advection_proxy: -(U700 * dN/dx + V700 * dN/dy) using 2D spatial finite differences
spatial_feature_formulations.cloud_fraction_temporal_tendency: (N(t0 + H) - N(t0 + H - 1h)) / 1h from MEPS D-1 18Z forecast run

causality_verification: All fields extracted from D-1 18Z forecast run (issued 6 hours prior to t0); 100% causal (t_issuance <= t0)
